decision: Use the existing ordinary ManagedCommit input path at an observed word boundary in a stock legacy client that has actually supplied a current SurroundingText callback. Preserve owned preedit for opaque clients and the explicit exact-refresh contract.
reason: Chrome renders its owned composition with an underline even for IBus UNDERLINE_NONE. The current entrypoint unnecessarily starts owned preedit after an actual stock-client boundary observation. The existing ManagedCommit path already records each commit's snapshot floor and requires a newer actual receipt for committed-word edit authority.

consequences: Commit timing changes only for the observed stock-client branch of the existing managed input. No new executor, text owner, callback, timer, queue or client-name branch. A successful CommitText is not a widget receipt: retain managed_commit_snapshot_floor, exact_managed_surrounding_word_is_current, snapshot/selection/sensitive guards, verifier and reducer unchanged.
